To learn more about the courses and programs offered at Sonoma State University or the General Education and Upper-division requirements for each major please refer to the university catalog at: http://www.sonoma.edu/catalog/","groupId":"d2ed7145-6887-ef11-8474-000d3a37e3b6","position":1,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

To be admitted to the English major, students must receive a grade of at least B- in ENGL 101 and 214 or their equivalents. Students with a grade lower than B- in either ENGL 101 or 214 may petition for a review by the department. All single subject concentration courses must be passed with a grade of C or better in order to qualify as meeting the waiver requirements. In addition, students must achieve a minimum GPA of 3.00 (in single subject program courses) to qualify for waiver approval.

","groupId":"fc337445-6887-ef11-8474-000d3a37e3b6","position":3,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

The AA-T in English (SB 1440 degree) has been deemed as \"similar\" degree to the English, B.A. (Literature and Creative Writing Concentrations) at Sonoma State. Students transferring to SSU with an AA-T in English are advised to complete all available articulated major requirement and support courses before transfer. It is also recommended that students complete the American Institutions (US-1, US-2, US-3), and Seawolf Studies Graduation requirements before transfer.

","groupId":"a7e77145-6887-ef11-8474-000d3a37e3b6","position":5,"area":"General"},{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

The Bachelor of Arts in English has three concentrations: Literature, Creative Writing, and Secondary Teaching Credential. Students in the Literature and Creative Writing Concentrations will need to complete the Major Core Requirements listed below. The additional Concentration information lists Lower Division course options. For a complete listing of Concentration requirements, please refer to the SSU catalog.The Secondary Teaching Credential Concentration requirements are listed under a separate major tab.
